department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India (run in Tamil Nadu by the Revenue Administration Department)
benefit: If the main earner of a poor family dies, the family gets Rs 20,000 one time. This helps the family in the hard days after the loss.

other: Your family must be below the poverty line.
The person who died must have been the main earner of the family.
The person who died must have been 18 to 59 years old.

how_to_apply: Apply online on the TN e-Sevai website (tnesevai.tn.gov.in). Revenue officers check your form. If you are eligible, the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) orders your help. Forms are settled within 30 days.

evidence.quote: The family receives Rs.20,000 as support to help them cope with
lump sum financial assistance in the unfortunate event of the death of its primary breadwinner
a household living below the poverty line becomes eligible
provided the deceased was between 18 and 59 years of age
வறுமைக்கோட்டிற்கு கீழ் வாழும் குடும்பங்களின் பொருளீட்டும் நபரின் வயது – 18 முதல் 59 வயதிற்குள்ளாக இருத்தல் வேண்டும்.
தனி வட்டாட்சியர் (சமூக பாதுகாப்புத் திட்டம்) மூலம் ஓய்வூதியம் வழங்க உத்தரவிடப்படுகிறது
சமூக பாதுகாப்புத் திட்டங்களுக்கு விண்ணப்பிக்கும் செயல்முறையை எளிதாக்குவதற்காக, https://www.tnesevai.tn.gov.in

gaps: The Tamil Nadu page lists the scheme and its age rule but not the amount; the Rs 20,000 comes from a central PIB note (Nov 2025).
The Tamil Nadu page says social security schemes are applied for on tnesevai.tn.gov.in; it does not name this scheme there by itself.
No list of papers (such as the death certificate), time limit to apply, helpline or G.O. number in the sources.
Age limits apply to the person who died, not the person applying, so age fields are left empty.
